variants.text:
The signs tend to show up early. She already knows we’re twin flames, or she tells me what I’m thinking before she’s asked me much, or I’m suddenly Lord Krishna. Maybe I really am much better than the men she’s used to. Fine. If she still can’t imagine anything about me disappointing her, she doesn’t know me yet.

I don’t help that fantasy by pretending my past disappeared. I still love women I’ve loved before, and sometimes I talk about them because they’re on my mind. I’m not trying to make her jealous. She can ask me to talk about them less. That’s fair. But if she needs me to act as if they vanished from my heart when I met her, she isn’t ready for me.

I also don’t want a rule where her whole inner life is welcome but mine has to be edited first.

I’ve learned to get nervous when somebody knows too much about me too soon. We’re twin flames. She knows my motives. I’m Lord Krishna. Okay, maybe I really am way better than the other guys she’s found. But if she hasn’t found anything about me that bothers her yet, she hasn’t found all of me.

I still love women I loved before her. Sometimes I talk about them because I’m thinking about them. I’m not trying to make her jealous, and she can tell me, “Can you talk less about your exes?” Sure. What I can’t do is pretend those women stopped mattering to me because a new relationship started.

If everything in her heart gets to be real while mine has to be cleaned up first, that’s not going to work for me.
